neighbours.label: the slot just before a Chinese place name (China, Manchuria) in Japan-China war and Chinese-history contexts; its output promotes ' China', ' Man(churia)', ' Chinese'
fire: After the Mukden Incident, the Japanese army quickly seized control of Manchuria.
By 1938 Japanese forces had pushed deep into central China along the Yangtze.
The League of Nations demanded that Japan pull its troops out of Manchuria.
During the Second Sino-Japanese War, millions of refugees fled toward western China.
Japanese bombers struck Chongqing repeatedly as the war in China dragged on.
The Nationalist government retreated from Nanjing deep into the interior of China.
Japan's puppet state was established in northeast China in 1932.
Soviet tanks rolled into Manchuria in the final week of the Pacific War.
quiet: After the Munich Agreement, the German army quickly seized control of the Sudetenland.
By 1941 German forces had pushed deep into western Russia along the Dnieper.
The League of Nations demanded that Italy pull its troops out of Ethiopia.
During the Spanish Civil War, thousands of refugees fled toward southern France.
German bombers struck Coventry repeatedly as the war in Britain dragged on.
The Polish government retreated from Warsaw toward the border with Romania.
Germany's puppet state was established in central Slovakia in 1939.
Allied tanks rolled into Bavaria in the final week of the European war.
